title: Canonical Multi-Indication Decision Support Scientific Policy Release v2.0
description: Authorizes indication-specific compatibility tuples, candidate generators, measurement capabilities, and parameters for MDD, Pain, Stroke, Aphasia, OCD, TBI, PTSD, and Tinnitus.

limitations: Personalisation unavailable without resting-state fMRI.
Requires split-half concordance >= 0.70.

disclaimers: FC map does not confer autonomous clinical authority.

limitations: Requires patient clinical safety clearance.
FC refinement requires minimum 8 minutes usable BOLD scan.
Target must be contralateral to reported pain side.
Motor hotspot repeatability must be <= 5.0 mm.
Repeatability exceeding 5.0 mm triggers fallback to somatotopic baseline.

disclaimers: Somatotopic M1 target does not replace neurological pain evaluation.

limitations: Research/Validation use only; Clinical mode disabled (§186).
Somatotopic target strictly contralateral to reported pain limb.
Requires verified LesionContext; suppressed if target tissue is destroyed.
Lesion mapping mandatory. No normal-template fallback permitted (§115, §147).
Lesion registration failure blocks targeting analysis.

disclaimers: Destroyed target coordinates cannot be shifted arbitrarily (§68).

limitations: Validation only; Clinical mode disabled (§187).
Mandatory native-space LesionContext. Absent lesion mapping triggers complete module abstention (§115, §147).
Requires chronic stage (>6 months post-stroke) and non-fluent phenotype (§148).

disclaimers: Right IFG target requires concurrent speech-language therapy context.

limitations: Research/Validation only (§188).
EvidencePath strictly requires chronic non-fluent aphasia. Stage/phenotype mismatch invalidates path (§148).
Requires deep-TMS H7 coil and symptom provocation context.
E-field coverage simulation required for deep-TMS field target.

disclaimers: Field targets cannot be delivered using conventional focal figure-8 coils (§78).

limitations: Validation only (§189).
Target geometry is coil_field. Downcasting to focal point target is strictly prohibited (§37, §149).
Research only. Cannot borrow MDD DLPFC evidence (§150).

disclaimers: TBI is a research-only module. Clinical target generation is prohibited.

limitations: Research only (§190).
Hard cross-indication rejection: Cannot borrow MDD DLPFC evidence or generators for TBI depression (§104, §150).
Partial applicability to combat-related PTSD; no hidden upgrade to full general applicability (§151).

disclaimers: Subpopulation applicability constraints must remain visible (§151).

limitations: Research/Validation only (§191).
Subpopulation constraints retained without hidden upgrade (§151). MDD evidence inheritance prohibited.
Research only. Clinical mode blocked with INDICATION_MODULE_NOT_CLINICALLY_PERMITTED (§152).
Audiology required. Prohibition of converting pitch match into tonotopic cortical target coordinate (§69, §105).

disclaimers: Tinnitus is Research-only. Cannot generate authoritative Clinical target slates (§152).

limitations: Research only (§192). Clinical mode strictly disabled. Requesting clinical mode yields INDICATION_MODULE_NOT_CLINICALLY_PERMITTED (§152).

globalProhibitions.description: Research-only IndicationModule cannot be executed in Clinical Mode (§103).
Research-only EvidencePath cannot establish Clinical targets (§103).
Unassigned evidence governance classification cannot confer Clinical authority (§32, §103, §154).
Unapproved or integrity-corrupted targeting plugin is prohibited in all modes (§53, §103, §156).
Unapproved candidate generator cannot nominate Clinical targets (§52, §103).
globalProhibitions.conditionPredicate: mode === clinical && generator.status !== permitted && generator.status !== required

globalProhibitions.description: Candidate generator not explicitly registered to IndicationModule is prohibited (§103).
Module execution on unaligned patient indication diagnosis is prohibited (§103, §104).
Target geometry unapproved for the active target family is prohibited (§36, §103, §149).
Research-only measurement capability cannot be used for Clinical targets (§41, §103).
Measurement capability with failed reliability check cannot be used without fallback (§42, §103, §145).
Measurement provider not listed in compatibility configuration is prohibited (§11, §103).
Acquisition profile violating minimum protocol requirements is prohibited (§103).
Normative model not explicitly authorized for the active indication is prohibited (§73, §103).
E-field simulation engine unverified for clinical target family is prohibited (§75, §103).
TMS device or coil class incompatible with target semantics is prohibited (§78, §103).
Scientific parameter outside validated bounds is rejected; silent clamping is prohibited (§91, §103, §157).
Entity lacking complete cryptographically traceable provenance is prohibited (§103, §125).
Scientific policy release lacking required cryptographic signatures or hash integrity is prohibited (§103, §126, §127).
Dynamic unpinned component version selectors (latest, ^, *) are strictly prohibited (§103).
Runtime dynamic scraping of scientific literature into targeting decisions is prohibited (§103).
Unverifiable LLM-generated coordinates or ranking outputs are prohibited (§103).
Non-deterministic runtime random numbers in clinical candidate generation are prohibited (§103).
Dynamic or outcome-driven weight auto-learning in clinical mode is strictly prohibited (§103, §108).
Administrative or UI override of frozen scientific thresholds is strictly prohibited (§103, §109).

parameterDefinitions.clinicalJustification: Validated minimum split-half sgACC-DLPFC concordance for patient-specific refinement.
Minimum incremental value required for refinement to displace evidence baseline (§64).
Spatial suppression distance for redundant DLPFC candidates.
Maximum allowed motor hotspot test-retest displacement for refinement qualification (§146).
Minimum gain for motor-map refinement over somatotopic M1 baseline.
Spatial clustering threshold for M1 somatotopic targets.
Minimum lesion segmentation agreement required for stroke motor targeting (§147).
Suppression radius between ipsilesional and contralesional motor candidates.
Spatial diversity radius for right IFG language candidates.
